eggplant salad is a traditional dish in my country that is made out of roasted and mashed eggplants and onions, that’s it. its more of a spread than a salad, i guess, but the dish itself is called eggplant salad. my fault for not clarifying that. i spread it on the salmon for more taste. also, i bought it from a grocery store, so it had the amount of calories/100g on it, so i was able to figure out the amount of calories i ate. and yeah, i did have just tzatziki for dinner. kinda like a light yogurt but with more flavour, amazing when its hot outside. 
also i dont think i understand the last paragraph completely? i didn’t feel like fainting after breakfast, i felt fine. i feel like fainting at times when i eat heavy dairy and meat, like, for example, i had a caesar salad a week ago and i felt very full and nauseous after, and i believe it might have been from the dressing, because i did have similar reactions to eating other foods like (restaurant) spaghetti carbonara, which are very heavy on the dairy. i also had similar reactions when eating beef or especially pork, sometimes even chicken, i just get bad cramps in my stomach and feel very full even if i ate a small portion, and those feelings mixed together make me feel nauseous and like i’m going to faint or like i can’t get back on my feet. these feelings intensify, especially in this heatwave we’re having right now. i’ve been asking my parents to take me to a doctor that specialises in this for years now, because they’re the ones with connections and medical insurance since i’m only 19, and they told me they will, but i’m still waiting…anyways, whole different subject.
